about: NIST SP 800-171A examine lists, one per requirement (110), vendored for the EO evidence index (EO-collection W4.1). The requirements array is copied verbatim from the source file named below; the evidence index cross-references each control's examine items against the evidence kinds present.

source.copiedFrom: ces-planner public/data/evidence-catalog/nist-800-171a-examine-lists.json (evidence catalog release 0; the same hash as catalog-releases.json examine_lists_sha256, checked by run check V29)
source.extractedFrom: NIST SP 800-171A (Examine lists; 'other relevant documents or records' omitted)

contractorTranscription.note: The contractor transcribed the 800-171A examine lists for seven requirements; BHD checked them row by row against NIST (evidence review of 2026-10-26, section 1.1): 3.1.1 to 3.1.6 match; the section the document labels 3.1.7 is the 3.1.9 list (relabelled here). Its wording is paraphrased in places, so the NIST-verbatim extraction is what is vendored; the document itself is not copied.

notes: Items are split on the semicolons NIST uses. Where NIST joins two objects with a comma inside one item (3.1.9: 'Privacy and security policies, procedures addressing system use notification'), the item is kept as NIST wrote it, so a list may have fewer entries than a reviewer who splits on commas would count.
Two lists (3.13.13 and 3.14.6) repeat an item; that is faithful to the NIST text. Do not require uniqueness within a list.
'Other relevant documents or records', the closing item of every list, is omitted.
Page header and footer text that the PDF extraction had embedded in three items (3.7.5, 3.10.5, 3.13.4) was removed on 2026-10-26; those items now read as in the PDF.
